zh.title: 華盛頓空中相撞事故後續審查提25項建議 籲增班前公開評估飛安
zh.summary: 美國國家科學、工程暨醫學學院指出，雷根華盛頓國家機場周邊仍有飛安風險，建議國會在核准增班前要求FAA公開安全與容量評估。
body: 美國國家科學、工程暨醫學學院11月18日公布國會委託的飛安審查。2025年1月29日，一架區域客機與一架美國陸軍直升機在雷根華盛頓國家機場附近相撞，兩機共67人罹難。這份報告以美國運輸安全委員會調查為基礎，提出25項建議。
委員會建議，國會未來若要核准機場增班，應先要求美國聯邦航空總署公開安全與容量評估。評估應納入航班在短時段內的集中程度、客機與直升機共用空域的情況，及航管人員工作負荷。報告也要求FAA與陸軍強化安全管理並追蹤已採措施的成效。

en.title: Washington midair collision review urges public safety assessment before more DCA flights
en.summary: A National Academies review makes 25 recommendations, including stronger safety oversight and a public assessment before Congress authorizes more flights.
body: The National Academies released a congressionally requested review on November 18 of aviation risks around Reagan Washington National Airport. It builds on the NTSB investigation of the January 29, 2025 collision between a regional airliner and a U.S. Army helicopter, which killed all 67 people aboard the two aircraft.

The committee recommended that Congress require the FAA to publish a safety and capacity assessment before allowing more flights at the airport. It urged reviewers to consider peaks in scheduled traffic, interactions between helicopters and airliners, and controller workload. It also called on the FAA and Army to strengthen safety management and track whether changes reduce risk.

facts.claim: The report presents 25 recommendations after the 2025 collision that killed 67 people.
The committee calls for a publicly reported assessment of DCA safety and capacity before Congress authorizes additional flights.
The committee recommends spreading flights more evenly across each hour to reduce peaks in controller workload.
The report calls for stronger safety management at the FAA and Army and improved collision protections.
